scientific_integrity: Claim supported by a complete characteristic-zero representation-theoretic proof and lattice local limit argument; finite exact checker is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Fixed germ asymptotic; constants are not uniform over varying germs.
Full Jordan type, not only the initial Milnor and Tjurina numbers, determines the variance.
No assertion about Hodge filtrations, mixed joins, or independence of review.
title: A universal square-root law for iterated Thom–Sebastiani Tjurina numbers
